Final interior return reuses actual Bruno footage. Repaired inserts retain hall doorway and same grooming platform.

Full-act audiovisual review found voice assignment consistent and jaw articulation adequate. Fifteen short audio fragments independently transcribed all required words without clipping. Isolated two-word voice-age classification varied; full source and AV context support Bruno ownership, not a second speaker.

Removed 1.333 seconds of lead/tail time after review. Selected lines retain measured speech windows; pauses remaining cover eyelines, evidence, location orientation and the lookalike reveal. Final new act 49.083 seconds, without replaying setup dialogue.

Reviewed contact sheets and whole-act video: no humans or broken body/prop interaction. Repaired flagged partial muzzle by cropping wholly below it; inspected new crop. Revised pawprint insert inspected: rounded toe pads and central pad, no fingers or limbs. All dialogue dogs remain seated.

Blind full-source and fragment transcription confirms complete dialogue. Original clipped alarm tail excluded and replaced. Hall Heidi and Sadie gain adjusted +2dB; reviewer found stable levels.
